name: avatar
title: Avatar
description: Photo that fades in over soft tinted initials (hue hashed from the name, ink picked for contrast), presence dots, notification badges and a verified seal cut into the edge, a gapped story ring that cross-fades to “seen”, and an AvatarGroup with cut-out borders, a +N chip and a staggered spring-in.
summary: A photo over hashed-colour initials, with presence dots and badges cut into the edge.
usage:
import { Avatar, AvatarGroup } from '@/components/ui/avatar';

<Avatar name="Ava Rossi" src="https://i.pravatar.cc/240?img=47" size="lg" status="online" />
<AvatarGroup max={3} total={12}>
  <Avatar name="Noah Kim" />
  <Avatar name="Priya Patel" />
  <Avatar name="Diego Alvarez" />
</AvatarGroup>
behavior: The photo fades in over the initials, a story ring cross-fades to a hairline once seen, and AvatarGroup springs its faces in with a stagger.
With onPress it becomes a button that springs down while pressed.
The status pulse, ring spin, press squish and group stagger are skipped, and the seen cross-fade is instant.
A light impact on press when onPress is set. Turn off with haptics={false}.
Read as an image (or a button when pressable) labelled with the name plus verified, status, notification and story details. A group reads its first names and "and N more".
props: Image URL. Fades in over the initials; falls back to them on error.
Initials, the deterministic fallback colour and the accessibility label.
Circle or rounded square (follows the kit radius).
Soft tint with deep ink, flat fill, or an opt-in two-tone gradient.
Presence dot in a ring cut-out: filled, crescent, bar, hollow.
Soft pulse behind the dot (off with reduce motion).
Solid accent ring with a clear gap. "seen" = story + seen.
Story watched: the ring cross-fades to a quiet hairline.
Ring colour override; the first entry is used as a solid colour.
Broken ring that spins — a loading story (circle only).
Rosette seal with a check, bottom-right (bottom-left if a status dot is shown).
Notification count (99+), or true for a dot, top-right.
Colour behind the avatar; cut-outs and group borders use it.
Soft drop shadow under the face.
Makes it a button with spring press feedback.
Real total when larger than what you pass.
Overlap as a fraction of the size.
Colour of the separating borders — match the parent.
Style for the avatar root; AvatarGroup applies it to its row.
